mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fee (fee_number, house_number, user_id, type, amount, due_date, paid, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{fee_number}, #{house_number}, #{user_id}, #{type}, #{amount}, DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE), false, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE fee SET paid = true, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE fee SET paid = true, updated_at = NOW() WHERE fee_number = #{fee_number}
UPDATE fee SET paid = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE fee_number = #{fee_number}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fee WHERE house_number = #{house_number} AND paid = false
SELECT user_id FROM fee WHERE fee_number = #{fee_number}
SELECT type FROM fee WHERE fee_number = #{fee_number}
SELECT house_number FROM fee WHERE fee_number = #{fee_number}
